Three new functions for S7-1200/1500 PLCs: acknowledge alarms from Node-RED, exchange data
blocks with a PLC program through BSEND/BRCV, and find object ids by name. **Upgrade if you
want to acknowledge alarms without an HMI, or if a PLC program must push data to Node-RED.**
Existing flows work as before.

## Highlights

- **Acknowledge alarms.** `s7 alarms` takes `msg.ack` (an alarm id, a list of ids, or `"all"`)
  and acknowledges the alarms, as the TIA Portal alarm display does. Each alarm then gives
  `state: "acknowledged"`, or `"ackFailed"` when the PLC refuses it (for example, its alarm
  class needs no acknowledgement). An alarm that went before its acknowledgement stays in the
  list until it is acknowledged, and the node status shows how many alarms wait. This writes to
  the PLC; the admin API does not allow it.
- **BSEND / BRCV.** A new endpoint protocol "S7 partner" connects to an S7 connection of the
  PLC. `s7 brcv` gives a message for each block that the PLC program sends with `BSEND`;
  `s7 bsend` sends `msg.payload` to a `BRCV` in the PLC. Blocks of up to 65534 bytes; the
  endpoint connects again after a PLC restart. The PLC needs an S7 connection to an
  unspecified partner (see the example flow "06 - BSEND and BRCV").
- **Find objects by name.** `s7 info` action `resolve` gives the object id of a DB, FB, OB or
  technology object by its name; `links` reads the objects that a relation points to (for
  example, the active alarms). Both are read only.

Tested on PLCSIM Advanced V8 (S7-1500, FW S4.1): alarms acknowledged in about 15 ms; BSEND/BRCV
with 16 and 1800 bytes both ways; resolve of DBs, FBs and OBs.

## Upgrade notes

- None. The new nodes and actions are additions; no option was removed or changed.
